'''Rayboo''' were antlered [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] found in the [[Water/Legends|icy]] wastelands of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. They were one of several [[Species/Legends|creatures]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] by the [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]].<ref name="NEGtAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rayboo were mentioned in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', which was written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and [[Helen Keier]].<ref name="NEGtAS" />
